topic: Proposed: fetch keyword hits' vectors lazily for one collection too
detail: SP-024.3 meets 1.3x because a search over several collections asks keyword requests for no vectors and fetches the dense vectors only of returned or tied keyword-only hits (same results). A search of one collection keeps the request it always made (INV-10). Measured on the SP-002 corpus, one collection with the lazy pattern is p95 8.3-8.4 ms against 18.0 ms today (default segments; 2.7-2.8 against 12.6 ms with 2 segments), so every search with no policy could be about twice as fast. Like for like, the collection-per-space layout still costs 2.0-2.4x one collection (D-24). Listed under 'Proposed new features' in PR #183.
